method: Sequential isolated native-loop browsers; full selected effects/audio, fixed 640x420 DPR1, no encoder. Same preset inputs and scene order, but not strict identical camera/phase/trajectory verification. Short 20 s samples do not validate robust P99, hardware or <=5% non-regression.

physicalAndroid.reason: No physical phone; UI emulation only.
